title: Microsoft is openly competing with OpenAI, Anthropic more than ever
summary: Microsoft pitched its own homegrown AI models and alternatives to competitors, signaling a strategic shift beyond partnerships. This demonstrates Microsoft's effort to diversify its AI capabilities and reduce dependence on external AI labs.
content: Microsoft pitched its own homegrown AI models, harnesses, and even a Mythos competitor on Wednesday, telling Wall Street it plans for continued growth.

zh.title: 微软与OpenAI、Anthropic的竞争比以往任何时候都更激烈
zh.summary: 微软推出了自主研发的AI模型和竞争对手替代品，标志着超越合作伙伴关系的战略转变。这表明微软努力实现AI能力多样化，减少对外部AI实验室的依赖。
